name: external-push-sink
title: External push sink for forwarder events
description: Add a fire-and-forget external push channel that delivers forwarder new/edited/deleted events as a canonical JSON envelope to HTTP webhook endpoints (ntfy/Bark/Slack compatible), with at-most-once delivery, snapshot-based routing, per-endpoint single worker, and drop-with-observability semantics, fully decoupled from the Telegram serial queue.
creator: killbus
